review_required_on: federal customer or agency requirement change

references.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
references.applies_when: Federal information-system, organization, privacy, or comparable high-assurance control catalog applies.
references.freshness_rule: Check NIST release metadata at least monthly and on every production-security review.

references.title: Secure Software Development Framework
references.applies_when: Software is designed, built, tested, packaged, deployed, or maintained.
references.freshness_rule: Check for a final superseding NIST publication on every dependency or build-policy change.

references.title: Zero Trust Architecture
references.applies_when: Identity, service, device, network, workload, or data access crosses a trust boundary.
references.owner: Runtime, provider, custody, and Site owners
references.freshness_rule: Revalidate on identity, credential, network, or service-boundary change.

references.title: Zero Trust Maturity Model
references.applies_when: Federal-aligned zero-trust maturity and cross-pillar integration are relevant.
references.owner: Runtime, provider, custody, and Site owners
references.freshness_rule: Check CISA publication status at least quarterly and before production activation.

references.title: Moving the U.S. Government Toward Zero Trust Cybersecurity Principles
references.applies_when: A federal zero-trust deployment, agency integration, or equivalent control objective is in scope.
references.freshness_rule: Revalidate against superseding OMB memoranda before federal deployment or acquisition claims.
